description: This file contains integration tests for complex search criteria on persistent 'Thing' objects, specifically testing various logical combinations (AND, OR, NOR) of attribute-based query conditions using the criteria framework.

classes.name: ComplexCriteriaIT
classes.description: Integration test class for evaluating complex search criteria on persisted 'Thing' objects, extending base test class.

methods.name: createTestData
methods.description: Sets up test data by inserting predefined generic 'Thing' attributes and IDs into persistence.

methods.name: findAllWithAndCriteria
methods.description: Tests selecting 'Thing' objects that match all specified attribute criteria (logical AND).

methods.name: findAllWithNoredAndCriteria
methods.description: Tests selection with a NOR of AND criteria, expecting to exclude specific combined matches.

methods.name: findAllWithOrCriteria
methods.description: Tests selection with OR criteria, returning 'Thing' objects matching any of the specified attribute conditions.

methods.name: findAllWithNoredOrCriteria
methods.description: Tests selection with NOR of OR criteria, expecting to exclude any matching either attribute condition.

methods.name: findAllWithNorCriteria
methods.description: Tests exclusion of 'Thing' objects matching any of multiple attribute values.

methods.name: findAllWithNorNorCriteria
methods.description: Tests inclusion criteria after nested NORs, returning objects that do not match specified attribute set.

methods.name: searchForKnownKey
methods.description: Constructs criteria searching for 'Thing' objects with a given attribute key and value.

methods.name: searchForValue
methods.description: Constructs criteria searching for 'Thing' objects with a specific attribute key and a known string value.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Creates and stores multiple test 'Thing' objects with various attribute configurations for testing.
